$comment: Retry/idempotency conformance. Defaults: maxRetries=2 (so at most 3 attempts), exponential backoff with full jitter (base 0.5 s, cap 8 s), Retry-After (seconds), when present, overrides computed backoff (contract 1.2.0 documents that the API sends Retry-After on every 429 and 503 and on 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS; when the header is absent, e.g. stripped by a proxy, the computed backoff applies). A POST is retried only with an Idempotency-Key, or when `retrySafe` is true (an operation marked x-retry-safe with no key, such as the unbilled POST /v1/estamp/orders/validate; those scenarios are `optional`). Operations marked x-retry-safe=false (cancel, replace, pan-card link, wallet top-ups, webhook replay) are never auto-retried. Retryable: 429, 502, 503, 504, connection errors, timeouts. POST is retried only when an Idempotency-Key is present; verification POSTs (POST /v1/verify/*) are billed, carry no idempotency key and are NEVER retried after a response was received. Sequence items: an HTTP status number, or the strings connection_error (failed before any response bytes) / timeout. `outcome` is the final status or error class.

scenarios.name: get-429-retry-after
scenarios.note: Retry-After (2 s) is honoured instead of the jittered backoff.

scenarios.name: post-orders-auto-key-reused
scenarios.note: SDK generated a UUIDv4 key because the caller supplied none; the same key is sent on every attempt.

scenarios.name: verify-gstin-429-never-retried
scenarios.note: A response was received, so the billed POST is not auto-retried even for 429.

scenarios.name: verify-pan-timeout-never-retried
scenarios.note: A timeout cannot prove no request bytes reached the server, so it is not retried.

scenarios.name: verify-bank-account-connection-error-pre-response
scenarios.note: OPTIONAL: SDKs that can prove the failure happened before any request was sent (e.g. DNS failure, connection refused) may retry; SDKs that cannot tell must NOT retry (expectedAttempts 1).

scenarios.name: verify-pan-negative-result-is-200
scenarios.note: Negative verification results are HTTP 200 and must not be retried or raised.

scenarios.name: get-429-no-retry-after-header
scenarios.note: A 429 without Retry-After (for example stripped by a proxy): fall back to the computed (jittered) backoff.

scenarios.name: verify-pan-503-with-idempotency-key-retried
scenarios.note: The hardened contract makes verification POSTs idempotent (x-idempotent) when an Idempotency-Key is sent: a retry replays the original result without a second charge. Only SDKs that send a key may retry; keyless verification POSTs stay single-attempt (see verify-pan-503-never-retried).

scenarios.name: post-replay-no-key-not-retried
scenarios.note: POST without an Idempotency-Key is never auto-retried.

scenarios.name: get-503-retry-after-honoured
scenarios.note: Contract 1.2.0 sends Retry-After on 503 as well as 429.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-orders-503-503-200-with-key
scenarios.note: Order creation spends money and REQUIRES an Idempotency-Key (400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED without one); the same key and body are replayed on every attempt. The 201 is the only documented success.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-orders-422-key-reused-not-retried
scenarios.note: The same key with a different body is 422; retrying cannot help.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-orders-402-not-retried
scenarios.note: Wallet short (error.details.wallet is STAMP_DUTY or SERVICE_FEE): top up first, then send a new request.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-orders-409-in-progress-honours-retry-after
scenarios.note: OPTIONAL: the contract says to resend the identical request after Retry-After while the first request is still running. A 409 with any other code (state conflict) is never retried; see post-orders-409-not-retried.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-orders-validate-503-then-200-retry-safe
scenarios.note: OPTIONAL: validate is a dry run (nothing created, not billed, x-retry-safe=true, no Idempotency-Key parameter), so an SDK may retry it; an SDK that only retries POSTs carrying a key must make exactly 1 attempt.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-document-upload-502-then-201-with-key
scenarios.note: multipart/form-data: re-read the file and re-send the whole body (a fresh boundary is fine) with the same Idempotency-Key.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-document-upload-400-not-retried
scenarios.note: FILE_TOO_LARGE, UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE, FILE_CONTENT_MISMATCH and VALIDATION_FAILED are all HTTP 400.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-order-cancel-503-not-retried
scenarios.note: x-retry-safe=false, no Idempotency-Key parameter.

scenarios.name: post-estamp-pan-card-link-202-single-attempt
scenarios.note: 202 Accepted is the success: the PAN card is processed asynchronously; poll GET /v1/estamp/stamps/{stampId} (panCard.status).

scenarios.name: post-stamp-duty-wallet-topup-503-not-retried
scenarios.note: Top-ups create a payment order and an invoice, take no Idempotency-Key and are x-retry-safe=false.

scenarios.name: post-service-fee-wallet-topup-429-not-retried
scenarios.note: Without an Idempotency-Key a POST is not auto-retried even on 429; surface Retry-After to the caller.
